explanation: ransW.xml is a per-file ransomware-attack record template under athinio/security/. It's structured to track individual files: LastAttackScannedAt, AttackDetected, FileOwnerEmail, NoOfFiles, and per-file File1_Info blocks with FilePath/IsItRansAttack/ResolutionStatus. All fields are empty in the extracted template -- no writer script for this file was found anywhere in this bundle, so it's unclear whether it's actively populated by a component outside this extraction or effectively dormant.

value_meanings.AttackDetected empty or 0: No attack recorded (or the file is simply never populated in this deployment).
value_meanings.AttackDetected=1: Would indicate a ransomware attack was recorded against at least one tracked file -- unconfirmed semantics since no writer script sets this field in this bundle.
value_meanings.IsItRansAttack=1 on a given File{N}_Info: Would flag that SPECIFIC file as ransomware-affected, distinct from the file-level AttackDetected summary flag.
